issues.description: conandata.yml contains 6 manually-added mirror URLs (gh-proxy.com, mirror.ghproxy.com, ghproxy.com, gitclone.com, moeyy.cn, kkgithub.com) in addition to the official GitHub URL. Rule R39 states CI automatically adds mirror fallbacks for GitHub URLs, so conandata.yml should only contain the official source URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove all mirror URLs and keep only the official URL: "https://github.com/scop/bash-completion/releases/download/2.17.0/bash-completion-2.17.0.tar.xz". CI will inject mirrors automatically.

issues.description: Template placeholder found: `url = ""  # CI fills this`. Rule 5 explicitly lists this pattern as a forbidden template placeholder that must be filled by the adapter before merge.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the url field to the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. url = "https://github.com/scop/bash-completion" or the cnb.cool制品仓 recipe URL.

issues.description: package_type attribute is not declared. Rule 2 states package_type must not be left empty. notes.md mentions package_type = "application" but the conanfile.py does not set it.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add package_type = "application" to the class attributes since bash-completion is a shell script package (not a library).

issues.description: Shell script only has `set -e` but is missing `set -u` and `set -o pipefail`. Rule 7 requires all scripts to start with `set -euo pipefail`.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change shebang to #!/bin/bash and use `set -euo pipefail`, or at minimum add `set -eu` (note: pipefail requires bash, not POSIX sh).

issues.description: The umask 077 fix is applied via replace_in_file() in build() method, modifying the generated `configure` file at runtime. Rule R14 recommends handling generated file modifications through patches/ or generate() instead.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider creating a third patch (0003-configure-umask-fix.patch) for the umask 077 modification, or move the replace_in_file call to generate().

issues.description: patches_applied field is empty ([]), but 2 patches (0001-config.guess.patch, 0002-config.sub.patch) are declared in conandata.yml and applied in conanfile.py build(). The patch_classification section lists them, but patches_applied should also reflect them.
issues.fix_suggestion: Populate patches_applied with the actual patch filenames: ["0001-config.guess.patch", "0002-config.sub.patch"]

issues.description: patch_classification entries have guard: 'pending', suggesting incomplete verification state. This should be resolved before PR submission.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update guard field to reflect final verification status (e.g., 'applied' or 'verified') instead of 'pending'.

issues.description: patch_generation section contains local build machine paths (/storage/Users/currentUser/tmp/builds/...). These paths are machine-specific and should not be in committed files.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove local build paths from patch_generation section or replace with relative/generic paths.

issues.description: Status inconsistency: notes.md header says '状态: published' (line 5) and first footer says '最终状态: published' (line 51), but final footer says '最终状态: built' (line 55) and manifest.yaml says 'status: built'. The header 'published' is misleading.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update notes.md header status to 'built' to match the final status and manifest.yaml.

issues.description: Output format uses 'PASS:'/'FAIL:' instead of the required '[ok]'/'[fail]' markers. Rule 9 specifies output markers should use [step], [ok], [fail], [warn] format with 8-space indentation for [ok]/[fail].
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace 'PASS:' with '[ok]' and 'FAIL:' with '[fail]' with 8-space indentation, e.g. echo "        [ok] bash-completion package verified"

summary: Audit of bash-completion 2.17.0 Conan recipe changes (9 files). No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. The test_package contains real assertions verifying installed content (file existence, directory structure, pkg-config file) and runs a test script — not an empty shell test. sha256 is a valid 64-char hex hash. manifest status 'built' is consistent with final notes status. Patches add legitimate HarmonyOS detection to config.guess/config.sub with real platform adaptation logic. 4 P2 code-style issues found: (1) conandata.yml manually lists 6 mirror URLs instead of only the official GitHub URL per R39, (2) conanfile.py has forbidden template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' per Rule 5, (3) package_type attribute not declared per Rule 2, (4) test_bash_completion.sh missing 'set -euo pipefail' per Rule 7. 6 P3 suggestions for improvements including empty patches_applied in manifest, status inconsistency in notes, umask fix in build() instead of patch, and output format deviations. Verdict: PASS — no blocking issues.
